messages:
maria: Quick sync — planning to enable the pii_audit_mode feature flag in prod for a staged canary. Need ops + infra sign-off on KMS/HSM fallback, retention TTL, and kill-switch names.
vikram: Can you call out the canary scope? percentage & which accounts?
mar ia: typo — maria here :wave: Canary plan: 10% of orgs, only internal/dev orgs and a small set of customer pilot accounts (we have a list). No global rollout without a green from eng-sre.
alex: 10% sounds reasonable. For retention I propose 30 days for audit logs (encrypted), with an option to truncate to 7d for sensitive customers. Thoughts?
sam: KMS/HSM note: we should prefer customer KMS key if provided, then fallback to our org KMS, and only hit HSM for the HSM-enabled tenants (HSM is rate-limited). Need to ensure we don't block inference path — HSM calls must be async.
mar ia: documenting fallback order is good. Also need explicit guardrail: if KMS/HSM latency > 200ms/operation for 2m window, auto-disable pii_audit_mode for that tenant and alert on pager.
vikram: agree on latency guardrail and an emergency global kill switch. Suggested kill-switch flag: pii.audit.disable-all (global) and per-tenant: pii.audit.disable.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging toggle applied: pii_audit_mode = true for staging canary group (ops-bot) :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks. Can we add a small config snippet to the FF service so ops can review?
sam: adding snippet here — please review:
```yaml
featureFlag: pii_audit_mode
enabled: false # flip to true for canary via controller
canary:
  percentage: 10
  audiences:
    - dev-internal
    - pilot-customers
kms_order:
  - customer_kms
  - org_default_kms
  - hsm_fallback
retention_days: 30
sensitive_retention_days: 7
kill_switches:
  global: pii.audit.disable-all
  tenant: pii.audit.disable
latency_guardrail_ms: 200
```
vikram: looks good. Ops: need the exact flag key for the UI + API. Also please add a metric: pii.audit.events.count and pii.audit.failure.rate, and an alert: failure.rate > 1% for 5m.
alex: PR is up: https://git.internal/repo/pull/4567 — includes flag wiring + unit tests. @sam can you take a quick look?
sam: will review in next hour. Quick test command for ops to toggle locally:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/flags/pii_audit_mode/toggle \
  -d '{"enabled":true, "scope":"canary"}'
```
maria: rollout plan summary —
1) smoke in staging (done)
2) enable 10% canary for dev/pilot accounts (scheduled)
3) monitor metrics & latency for 30m, run regressions on eval set
4) expand to 50% only if no regressions / alerts
5) full rollout with customer opt-in and docs

maria: scheduled prod canary start: 2026-05-02 16:00 UTC — ops please confirm maintenance window and any extra watch resources.
ops-bot: ops-scheduler: maintenance window reserved 2026-05-02 16:00-17:00 UTC. Pager on-call: vikram.
vikram: I'll be on-call and watching alerts. If anything spikes, flip pii.audit.disable-all and report here. :+1:
alex: pinging reviewers again. Need an approval before prod canary.
sam: LGTM pending two minor comments (docs + inline timeout). Will approve after addressing.
maria: thanks all — please add any additional risks here. If none, I'll post the final rollout note and checklist in #eng-release when approved.
